slug: 2026-04-27 Smart Africa drives cross-border data interoperability through SADX Technical Mission

facts.fact: Smart Africa held a Smart Africa Data Exchange technical assessment mission in Kigali with representatives from Rwanda, Benin and Ghana, so Ghana took part in a meeting of a Smart Africa programme; no agreement is reported signed.

systems.platform: federated, decentralised exchange with PKI trust chains and API contracts
systems.tiers: identification authorities, immigration agencies and national ICT institutions of Rwanda, Benin and Ghana
